eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 3:56 PM on AUG 24, 2020 Effective until 5:56 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Plumas County Sheriffs Office with a Mandatory Evacuation notice for the residents on Highway 70 from Chandler Road east to Squirrel Creek due to a wildfire You should leave the area immediately If you remain emergency personnel may not be able to help you An evacuation center is set up at Quincy High School
